verdict.rationale: Spline's own docs describe prompt-driven AI agents that produce real designs. Hana's AI Agent builds a described screen on the canvas, including layout, type, colour, effects, states and interactions. The 3D AI Agent "builds and edits 3D scenes" through the editor itself, and AI 3D Generation and AI Textures add text-to-model and text-to-texture generation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality, and explicit documentation of prompt-based editing (not just generation) of existing 2D Hana screens.

support.subject: As a designer, I can generate or edit designs from a natural-language prompt — first drafts, layouts, or full mockups the tool actually produces

citations.quote: Hana's **AI Agent** designs for you. Describe a screen and it builds it on the canvas: layout, type, colour, effects, states and interactions.

The AI Agent builds and edits 3D scenes for you. Describe what you want and it does the work through the editor itself — creating objects, setting up materials and lighting, animating, wiring interactivity
describe a screen and Hana designs it, then edit it by hand
AI 3D Generation is a new feature in Spline that allows anyone to transform textual descriptions and 2D images into 3D models with the help of AI.
